name: proto-unsupported-thinking
about: 推理设置与参数格式不兼容时，请求发出前就以 unsupported_thinking 结束（model/thinking/registry.ts:39-89 resolveThinkingPlan 的各个 fail 分支 + throwIfUnsupportedThinkingPlan）。model_stream 走公共 host 时基线在 200 头之后断连接、采集器记不下来（见 proto-anthropic-request.gen.mjs 开头），这里改走普通 submit_turn（modelOverride 选模型、set_session_thinking 选强度 high）：u1 server-default 格式选了强度；u2 server-default 而模型关闭推理；u3 强度不在 efforts 里；u4 moonshot kimi-k3 用 provider 格式时关闭推理；u5 只支持预算推理的老 Claude 模型选了强度；u6 非 gemini-3 的 Gemini 选了强度；u7 Gemini 关闭推理。比较事件（model_error 的 code / message）、落盘与 provider 收到的请求（主请求应当一个都没有）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        sd-effort:
          thinking:
            state: enabled
            efforts: [high]
            format: server-default
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        sd-off:
          thinking:
            state: disabled
            format: server-default
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        few-efforts:
          thinking:
            state: enabled
            efforts: [low]
            format: openai
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    moonshot:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        kimi-k3-bbx:
          thinking:
            state: disabled
            format: provider
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/anth/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        claude-3-5-bbx:
          thinking:
            state: enabled
            efforts: [high]
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    gem:
      protocol: google
      url: {MOCK}/gem
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        gemini-2.5-bbx:
          thinking:
            state: enabled
            efforts: [high]
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        gemini-3-off:
          thinking:
            state: disabled
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
